_about: Status of every goal in Almanac Development Log.docx, the milestones, and what shipped when. refresh.py joins this with the log itself: a goal added to the log shows on the dashboard at the next refresh, marked untracked until it gets an entry here. Keys are the goal's text, lowercased with punctuation dropped. Statuses: done, in_progress, planned (scheduled in a milestone), not_started, ongoing (a standing practice).

always playtest.note: Bots, the demo game, and local playtest and rehearsal servers. A full rehearsal game ran before the Nov 10 deploy.

reasonably maintainable.note: One spec (CLAUDE.md) kept current, and an automated test suite that runs before every deploy.

appropriate environments.note: Local dev, playtest and rehearsal servers, and production on Fly. No staging site and no version control yet.

dont overdo it.note: One machine, SQLite, full snapshots instead of diffs; no new services without a reason.

leaderboard screen five seconds.note: The scores screen still defaults to 10 seconds. A host can set 5 in the settings drawer.

join app option when waiting for game to.note: Phones have Game, Locker and Shop views in every phase.

still in game lobby and will return to t.note: The host setting 'recall on start' brings every phone back to the game.

better questions.note: 365 playable questions after the Nov 11 verifier run, case questions for the club, and the automated verifier.

figure out what constitutes a good quest.note: Style rules written into the spec (arbitrary beats geography, stable answers, named years). Not yet tested against playtest results.

multiple progression.note: Coins, XP and levels, prestige, achievements and Academia.

redesign prestige.note: Prestige now comes from wins, podiums and Best Quotes.

player banner at top of screen.note: The locker's preview card collapses into a slim bar pinned to the top.

moves with you as you scroll.note: It follows the scroll without changing height.

crowded.note: Lobby chips kept plain, and avatars and banners stand still during play. No full declutter pass yet.

banner at beginning of catalog.note: Banners have their own marketplace tab, third after Bundles, not first.

hairstyles better and broader free.note: Hair redrawn, five styles added, the 12 everyday cuts free.

competitive matchmaking.note: Last in M6: it needs enough players to match. The nightly live game (built Nov 10) comes first to gather them.

anti cheat.note: Accuracy flagging, the review page, and the decided penalty: confirmed players are left off the live tables.

track how close quotes bids etc are to r.note: Tracked and flagged: players far more accurate than everyone else are shadow-flagged for your review at /admin/flags. Punishment isn't automatic, by design.

friends function.note: Requests by game log, room, friend code or handle search; blocking.

communities group clan functions.note: Groups with owners, leaderboards and members-only rooms.

local function.note: Nearby-game discovery, on live mode's plumbing.

speak to play.note: Kept as an experiment, not a milestone.

voice identification.note: Kept as an experiment, not a milestone.

send invite to groups with notifications.note: Play now invites every member, through the bell and phone notifications.

game log go back to see players add frie.note: Every saved game has a log with the table, rounds, trades and Add friend.

profile expansion bio achievements.note: Bio, badge shelf and the achievements page.

profile picture is visible when selectin.note: The locker's preview card shows the avatar and name card live.

hairstyles free.note: Every everyday cut is free; buyers of now-free styles were refunded.

avatars more realistic.note: Hair redrawn to look like real cuts. Faces and bodies unchanged.

tiktok posting agent.note: Planned as an offline tool run from your machine, like the verifier.

added_goals.goal: Grow the bank to 1,000 playable questions
added_goals.note: Set Nov 11, 2026 so the endless table can run all day without repeats. 365 playable after the Nov 11 verifier run, up from 162, and live since the Nov 12 deploy.

added_goals.goal: Research a batch of about 250 new questions
added_goals.parent: Grow the bank to 1,000 playable questions
added_goals.note: 245 added Nov 11 (230 standard across ten categories, 15 case), all unverified until the verifier passes them.

added_goals.goal: Run the verifier on the new batch
added_goals.parent: Grow the bank to 1,000 playable questions
added_goals.note: Run Nov 11 on Haiku for $5.89: 203 of 245 passed, 10 need review, and 32 are still unverified because the connection dropped. Rerun with --limit 32 to finish.

added_goals.goal: No repeats within a week on the endless table
added_goals.note: The table holds back the most recent half of its pool now; a week without repeats needs the bank near 1,000.

added_goals.goal: One menu that leads to every page
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11: the app opens on a menu that links every other page, and each page's wordmark leads back.

added_goals.goal: Social, Play and Customization as three screens you swipe between
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11: Play in the middle, a tab bar that follows the swipe, side by side on a wide screen.

added_goals.goal: Social redesigned from the sketch: your card, then Groups and Friends as sliding tabs
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11: it replaced the separate Social page; the handle, notifications and public profile moved to the profile page.

added_goals.goal: The Social, Play and Customization bar on every page outside a game
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11: left off the phone's game view and the host screen only.

added_goals.goal: A global leaderboard on Social: groups and players by prestige
added_goals.note: Live Nov 12: a podium of the top three at the top of Social, and the top fifty of each at /leaderboard.

added_goals.goal: Shields, combined prestige, and a start-a-group dialog
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11: group icons are shields, 13 fuller drawings were added, each group shows its members' prestige added up, and one dialog sets the name, bio and shield for 1,500 coins.

added_goals.goal: Invite players from the group page, with a link to share
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11: copy the link, share it from the phone, or show a QR code; the owner can replace it. Shared links preview with the group's name and picture.

added_goals.goal: Group customization: a bio, icon drawings and colours, uploaded pictures
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11: 26 shield drawings on 8 colours, or a picture the server redraws before storing. Bios and pictures can be reported.

added_goals.goal: Starting a group costs 1,500 coins
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11: existing groups were free and stay; disbanding returns nothing.

added_goals.goal: The host-group invite: a signed-in host invites the table to a group, before and after the game
added_goals.note: Live Nov 17: the host picks any group they're in, every phone gets a pop-up to join, and the offer can go out again on the final scores.

added_goals.goal: The host as a second entity: one account hosts on one screen and plays from another
added_goals.note: Live Nov 17: the host screen carries the account's name, avatar and groups without taking a seat, and can sign in where it is.

added_goals.goal: A table that never closes, open to anyone at any time
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11 at /open: room OPEN, a question in under a minute, idles when nobody is there.

added_goals.goal: House bots that never know the answer
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11: one shared wrong view per question, market-making quotes that learn from trades and the hint.

added_goals.goal: Points, coins and XP every round, with daily and weekly boards
added_goals.note: Live Nov 11. Points won off the house pay a quarter of the coins; sitting idle earns nothing.

added_goals.goal: A second table when the first fills
added_goals.note: One table of up to 120 for now.

added_goals.goal: Overlapping markets, so one is always closing
added_goals.note: Several questions open at once with no sealed-quote wait. A bigger change to the screen and the messages.

added_goals.goal: Scale past one machine
added_goals.note: Diffs instead of full snapshots, and tables pinned to machines. Only needed with thousands online.

added_goals.goal: A players page: every account's XP, prestige, coins and record
added_goals.note: Live Nov 17 at /admin/players: a sortable, searchable table read live from the game, with totals and an Excel download.

added_goals.goal: Teammates can be given view access to the players page
added_goals.note: Live Nov 17: admins add a teammate by email on the page; teammates can view and download but see no emails or accuracy flags.

added_goals.goal: An overview page: the app's structure, services and live status in one place
added_goals.note: Live Nov 17 at /admin/overview: a chart of the app's layers, every page, module and table, the outside services, and live status.

added_goals.goal: Plans and goals where every contributor can see them
added_goals.note: Live Nov 17: milestones, what is in progress and next, every goal by area, and what shipped when, on the same page.

added_goals.goal: Legendary and mythical items animate on every page
added_goals.note: Live Nov 17: on the host screen, the phone's game view and the leaderboards, legendary and mythical effects, outfits and banners keep moving; everything else still holds still there.

milestones.name: Engine

milestones.name: Hot-seat demo
milestones.summary: One page, one question, to find out whether the game is fun without a market maker.

milestones.name: Rooms
milestones.summary: Host screen and phones over WebSockets, timers, sealed quotes, Best Quote, reconnect; live on Fly.

milestones.name: Accounts
milestones.summary: Optional Google sign-in, saved results and coins.

milestones.name: Avatars and marketplace
milestones.summary: Avatars on every name, a priced catalog, bundles, the locker, free everyday hair.

milestones.name: Host tools
milestones.summary: Categories, bots, demo, play again, paces, late join, drinks mode, case questions.
milestones.open: Quote sizes 1-3; pause timers when the host disconnects.

milestones.name: Identity and progression
milestones.summary: XP and levels, prestige, banners and Academia, achievements, profiles, game log, end-of-game awards.

milestones.name: Social
milestones.summary: Friends, groups and members-only rooms, the bell, reports, and phone notifications.

milestones.name: Modes that need a crowd
milestones.summary: Live mode, anti-cheat, the open table, nearby games, matchmaking, public rooms, app-store wrappers.
milestones.open: Anti-cheat flagging and the nightly 9 PM live game are live (Nov 10), and the open table (Nov 11). Still to come: live reminders and watching, a second open table, nearby games, matchmaking, public rooms and app wrappers.

timeline.title: Spec written
timeline.detail: The game, the stack and the milestones, in CLAUDE.md.

timeline.title: Engine, rooms and first deploy
timeline.detail: M0 to M2, the question verifier, and almanac-game.fly.dev.

timeline.title: Accounts, avatars and host tools
timeline.detail: Google sign-in, coins, the marketplace, bots, drinks mode, 120-player rooms.

timeline.title: Progression and social
timeline.detail: Levels, prestige, Academia, achievements, game log; friends, groups and the bell.

timeline.title: Case questions
timeline.detail: 43 researched case questions for the fintech club, with longer timers and figure hints.

timeline.title: Case modes, phone notifications, dashboard, M6 begins
timeline.detail: Extra/Default/Off switch with 1.5x-2.5x points, web push, this dashboard, anti-cheat accuracy flags, and the nightly 9 PM live game.

timeline.title: The open table and a bigger question bank
timeline.detail: A table that never closes, with house bots that don't know the answer and points every round, live at /open; 245 new questions researched, waiting on the verifier. A main menu of three swipeable screens, live the same day. Group invite links, customization and a 1,500-coin cost to start one, then the Social screen redrawn from a sketch and a navigation bar on every page, all live the same day.

timeline.title: A global leaderboard, and 203 new questions verified
timeline.detail: Groups and players ranked by prestige, at the top of Social and at /leaderboard. The verifier passed 203 of the 245 new questions, taking the bank to 365 playable. Both went live the same day.

timeline.title: The host-group invite
timeline.detail: A signed-in host screen invites the whole table to one of its groups, in the lobby and again after the game, with a pop-up on every phone. The host is its own entity, so the same account can host and play. Live the same day.

timeline.title: A players page for the team
timeline.detail: Every signed-in account in one live table at /admin/players, with an Excel download, and view access for teammates. Live the same day.

timeline.title: An overview page for the team
timeline.detail: An organizational chart of the app at /admin/overview: how it fits together, its plans and the services it runs on. Live the same day.

timeline.title: Top-tier items move everywhere
timeline.detail: Legendary and mythical effects, outfits and banners now animate on the host screen, the phone's game view and the leaderboards, so the two top tiers show off during a game. Live the same day.

timeline.title: 800 coins for every account
timeline.detail: A one-off gift: every account that existed that day was credited 800 coins, once. Accounts made later start with the usual welcome coins.

timeline.title: A quieter host invite and social pages
timeline.detail: The host's group invite became one small button that shows the host's groups only when pressed, and the social pages stopped naming prestige: the star and the number stay, the word doesn't.
